🎙️ Edge Talk: Juulia Turkkila & Matthias Versluis

New season, big motivation. The Finnish ice dance team sit down for Edge Talk to discuss what's driving them this year, with a home World Championship in Tampere on the horizon! 🇫🇮⛸️✨
